prompt: A tall five-tier oak bookshelf filled with books of varied heights, thicknesses and spine colors, some leaning, one small stack lying flat, plus a potted succulent and a small framed photo (plain color, no image) on the shelves.

Over-ear wireless headphones in matte black with rose-gold accents: padded headband, extendable sliders, oval ear cups with soft leatherette cushions, a small LED and power button on the right cup. Slowly turntable-rotate the model.

A city bicycle with a diamond frame in forest green, spoked wheels, a front basket, fenders, a brown saddle and handlebar grips, and a chain drive. Animate the pedals and wheels turning in sync; add a play/pause button.
A vermilion Japanese torii gate standing on a gravel path, flanked by two stone lanterns with a warm glow inside, a few stepping stones, and small maple trees with red leaves. Soft dusk lighting.

A potted monstera plant: a terracotta pot with soil, several long stems, and large glossy split leaves with characteristic holes (fenestrations), leaves oriented in different directions. Leaves sway very gently.

A skeleton wall clock with visible interlocking brass gears of different sizes behind a transparent face, roman numerals on a ring, hour/minute/second hands showing the real current time, and gears rotating at correct relative speeds.

A three-layer round birthday cake on a white cake stand: pastel pink frosting with piped rosettes on top, sprinkles, a drip of chocolate glaze down the sides, and five lit candles with flickering flame lights.

A grocery store aisle about 8 m long: metal shelving units on both sides with four shelves each, densely stocked with generic unbranded products (cereal-like boxes, bottles, cans, jars) in varied colors and sizes, price-tag strips on shelf edges, overhead fluorescent lights, and a shopping cart in the aisle. Camera at 1.6 m eye height looking down the aisle.

An original small explorer robot (not based on any existing IP): boxy body on two tank treads, a single round camera-eye on a neck that tilts, a small antenna with a blinking light, and one arm holding a flashlight casting a spotlight. Idle animation: looks around.

A wooden chess board with a checkered maple/walnut pattern and a full set of 32 pieces (pawns, rooks, knights, bishops, queens, kings) built procedurally with lathe geometry, arranged in the starting position. Knights may be stylized.
